trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. [1][10] Expect about 200 hours in total: 60–80 of story, about 100 on the 100% checklist, and 10–20 of cleanup. [1][3] Everything is single-player and offline, in one playthrough. [1][5][6]
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops. [1][10]
Expect about 200 hours in total — PowerPyx breaks it into 60–80 hours of story, about 100 hours on the 100% checklist, and 10–20 hours of cleanup. [1][3][6]
Push Square puts the total higher, at 300 hours or more, so treat 200 as the low end of the range. [7]
Everything is single-player and offline, in one playthrough; there are no online trophies, no difficulty setting, no New Game+, and no mission replay. [1][5][6]
Keep cheats off the whole run: any cheat disables trophies and saving. [1][5][8]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the hardest trophy on the list, and the gate to the platinum. [1][5] The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. [5] Its thresholds are lenient: PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion. [1]
steps: Finish the story first: the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) shows up after the story, but everything you did before already counts. [5]
Clear every robbery in full: all 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, and 8 bank vault robberies. [3][5]
Finish the full-requirement collectibles: every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks, and all 33 underwater discoveries. [3][5]
Hit the partial thresholds: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, and 100 WAiNK scans. [5]
Nothing on the checklist is missable, and its thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion. [1][5]
Track it in-game at any time (Touch Pad > Progress) and after the story under Progress > 100% Completion. [7]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, and 25 base jumps. [5] Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up. [4][5] The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one. [5]
steps: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, and 25 base jumps. [5]
Flying under bridges is the quickest kind to rack up. [4][5]
The optional challenge on each stunt is not needed for the count. [5]
Track it under Progress > Activities > Stunts; the map can show every Stunt Spot. [5]
Keep going after this pops: the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts. [4][5]

Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. [5]
The last one, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy. [5]

[5] Five of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. [5]

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. [5] Take its three valuables — the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs) — and the trophy pops once you lose the police. [5] You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back. [5]

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). [5] Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. [5] After the story you can also train at home. [5] This one rests on a single source, so treat the method as the best available report, not a confirmed fact. [5]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. [5] Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. [5] Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent. [4][5] This one rests on a single source. [5]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the app: take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them, and register them. [5] At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. [5] You need free garage space (see Little Boxes), and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. [5]
